name: Elephant Rocks State Park
story: Elephant Rocks State Park is a geologic reserve in the Saint Francois Mountains in the U.S. state of Missouri. It features large granite boulders formed 1.4 billion years ago that resemble a train of pink circus elephants. The land was donated to the state in 1967.
matters: The park preserves a unique outcropping of Precambrian granite and includes an abandoned quarry. It is managed by the Missouri Department of Natural Resources.
